reply_text:
The debugger is attached again in the Agency JVM (`:7070`). I re-read its state from that JVM afterwards: attached, no stopped runs, no breakpoints armed.

- **How:** I loaded `futon2.aif.wm.debugger` from futon2 HEAD; that tree has no uncommitted changes. Before attaching I confirmed there were no stopped runs, as step 0 of A-self-heal requires.
- **Why it will hold:** the War Machine runner isn't loaded yet, so it will load at the next click. It only `require`s the debugger namespace, which won't reload a namespace that's already loaded, so the attachment survives until the next JVM restart.
- **When a phase fails:** the run pauses and shows up in `(futon2.aif.wm.debugger/stopped)`. You then choose with `(continue! run-id :retry)` or `:abort`.
- **No breakpoints armed:** add them if you want pauses on success too. `(arm-breakpoint! [:after phase])` stops after a given phase; `(arm-breakpoint! :outer-selection-complete)` stops once outer selection completes.

I've added the re-attach steps to the memory note, because every restart will clear this again.
